lanes.notes: Runs the repository-authored Octane hook type contract, including native event and schema behavior.

divergences.upstreamResult: The React package publishes ./mcp-apps and MCPAppResource backed by @mcp-ui/client.
divergences.octaneResult: The Octane package publishes only the portable bridge hook on its root entry.
divergences.rationale: The renderer dependency is React-only and has no Octane equivalent.
divergences.consumerImpact: MCP resources cannot be rendered through the upstream React component.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Use useMcpAppBridge and provide an Octane-native renderer.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review when an Octane MCP UI renderer exists.

divergences.upstreamResult: React examples and host props use synthetic onChange events.
divergences.octaneResult: Octane consumers use native onInput events.
divergences.rationale: Octane exposes native DOM event semantics.
divergences.consumerImpact: Input handlers receive native event objects.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Replace React onChange handlers with typed native onInput handlers.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane adds React-compatible synthetic events.

divergences.upstreamResult: React supports StrictMode effect replay and includes a random identifier fallback.
divergences.octaneResult: Octane provides useId and does not double-invoke effects.
divergences.rationale: The host lifecycle and identifier facilities differ.
divergences.consumerImpact: Hook clients retain one stable generated identifier without StrictMode replay.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Do not depend on React StrictMode double invocation.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane adopts StrictMode replay semantics.

divergences.upstreamResult: Devtools clients identify their framework as react.
divergences.octaneResult: Devtools clients identify their framework as octane.
divergences.rationale: Tooling must report the active renderer truthfully.
divergences.consumerImpact: TanStack AI Devtools label this binding as Octane.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Expect octane in devtools framework metadata.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if upstream adds a renderer-neutral framework option.

divergences.upstreamResult: Version 0.17.0 captures the first realtime token getter and adapter.
divergences.octaneResult: Reconnects and refreshes use the latest options.
divergences.rationale: Long-lived realtime clients must observe rerendered credentials and adapters.
divergences.consumerImpact: Credential and provider rotation works without remounting.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Updated callbacks and adapters take effect on the next operation.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review when upstream reads current realtime options.

divergences.upstreamResult: Version 0.17.0 drops the declared external onStatusChange callback.
divergences.octaneResult: Status changes update hook state and invoke the latest external callback.
divergences.rationale: The declared callback is part of the public options contract.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Use onStatusChange without a separate polling workaround.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review when upstream invokes the callback.

divergences.upstreamResult: Version 0.17.0 captures the initial chat transport.
divergences.octaneResult: Changing connection or fetcher updates the client while retaining conversation state.
divergences.rationale: Transport rotation should not discard a live conversation.
divergences.consumerImpact: A rerender can replace transport credentials or endpoints in place.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Pass the new transport; do not remount the chat hook.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review when upstream updates active client transports.

divergences.upstreamResult: The tagged upstream test source references ChatClient.maybeAutoResume.
divergences.octaneResult: The pinned published client exposes no such method and the hook exposes no auto-resume contract.
divergences.rationale: The referenced API is absent from the pinned and latest published dependency.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Resume explicitly until the client package publishes the API.
